Mathématicienne et astronome d'Alexandri: A mathematician and astronomer in Alexandria, she taught philosophy to students who came from afar. Her student Synesius owed her the art of building an astrolabe, and wrote to her asking her to have a hydroscope made for him. She was murdered by a Christian mob in 415.
Calculatrice à la NASA, elle vérifie à l: A NASA “computer,” she checked by hand the trajectories for John Glenn's mission in 1962. Glenn had asked: “Get the girl to check the numbers. If she says they're good, I'm ready to go.”
Astronome de la cour des Han, il constru: An astronomer at the Han court, in 132 he built a bronze seismoscope: eight dragons each held a ball, which dropped into a toad's mouth on the side of the earthquake. In 138, a ball dropped without anyone in the capital feeling anything. A messenger confirmed the earthquake a few days later.
À 23 ans, il écrit un traité en vers où: At 23, he wrote a treatise in verse stating that the Earth spins on itself, which explains the apparent motion of the stars. He gave π as 3.1416 and explained eclipses by the shadows of the Earth and Moon, not by a demon swallowing the Sun.
« Calculatrice » à l'observatoire de Har: A “computer” at the Harvard observatory, paid 30 cents an hour, she studied thousands of variable stars on photographic plates. In 1912, she discovered that the brightest Cepheids blink more slowly. That was the yardstick that would let Hubble measure the distance to Andromeda.
Dans sa thèse de 1925, elle montre que l: In her 1925 thesis, she showed that stars are made mostly of hydrogen and helium. The astronomer Henry Norris Russell persuaded her to write that this result was “almost certainly not real.” Four years later, he reached the same conclusion and published it.
Ce dominicain défroqué affirme que l'Uni: This defrocked Dominican claimed that the Universe is infinite and that the stars are suns surrounded by planets, perhaps inhabited. He was burned in Rome in 1600. His countless worlds were among the charges, but alongside theses on the Trinity and Christ that weighed more heavily.
En mesurant la vitesse des étoiles dans: Measuring the speed of stars in galaxies, she found that those at the edge orbit as fast as those at the center: an invisible mass is missing. It is the best evidence for dark matter. At Mount Palomar, with no women's restroom, she taped a paper skirt onto the pictogram.
